info.name: secrets-rotation-orchestrator Postman Collection
info.description:
Coordinates zero-downtime rotation of credentials across every service, 
database, and consumer. Manages the full lifecycle: new secret generation, 
phased rollout to consumers, validation, then revocation of the old secret. 
Prevents the classic "rotated the password and everything broke" scenario 
by ensuring every consumer has adopted the new credential before the old 
one is destroyed.


OpenAPI version: 2.0.0

variable.description: Override with the base URL of the deployed Apigee proxy.
